name: Desjardins ConUHacks Adventure Banking App
tagline: A banking app that camouflages itself with camera colours, works as a compass and hides details when someone else appears.

awards: Desjardins - Sponsor Challenge // Desjardins - Défi commandité

problem: The sponsor challenge asked for banking that adapts to an adventurer's environment.
solution: Web-based banking with deposits and investments, a camera-driven camouflage theme, a compass mode for a second device, hands-free voice control and person detection that hides account details.
demo_moment: Team-described: point the camera at a scene and watch the app recolour.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Desjardins - Sponsor Challenge // Desjardins - Défi commandité” among 260 submissions.
Adds privacy protection on top of the playful features.

lessons: Pair a playful feature with a serious one so the idea survives questions.
